_comment: Professional licences, keyed by normalised business name. Kept out of src/data/records.json because that file is gitignored and rewritten by `bun run pull` — a licence found by hand would be lost on the next pull. Keyed by name rather than business id because every re-order mints a new id for the same company. Emptied 2026-09-22: the one entry, an NPI Registry record for Kairos Physical Therapy, was not a real lookup and has been withdrawn.
